text: At its meeting held on November 21, 2019, the Toronto Police Services Board was in receipt of a report from Chief Mark Saunders dated October 24, 2019 with regard to the 2018 Annual Statistical Report of the Toronto Police Service.
City Council on January 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (October 24, 2019) from the Chief of Police for information.
